notes: batch-0345 (mechanical rendering batch, 2026-11-11, parent batch-0344=0056bb1edb3). Uniform mechanical fixes for four rendering-defect families via one generator (/tmp/gen0345.py, spec /tmp/spec0345.json, overrides /tmp/override0345.json): 511 edited comment lines / 37 files (503 by the generator + 8 post-review delta customs); every parity-regime line asserted to per-line EN byte parity in LINE space (full line incl indent vs REL_16_11 full line), 167 legacy lines (already over EN before the batch, e.g. P1-era xact.c/xlog.c) edited transformation-only with no parity assert, disclosed. Families: D tight CJK<->Latin/digit adjacency -> insert one ASCII space (718 sites detected; rule per corpus majority 119k spaced vs 0.7k tight adjacencies); FC closer glue CJK*/ -> insert one space before */ (507 sites; corpus 15351 spaced vs 505 glued one-liner closers, EN side spaced in all 505); FO opener glue /*CJK (30); FB decor-bullet glue (27); HW half-width punctuation after CJK at clause end -> fullwidth (46 sites detected: 27 ASCII periods all in spi.c, 19 ,;: elsewhere; 40 applied as fullwidth, 6 REVERTED to EN half-width form in the post-review delta-2 - the partbounds.c '(模数, 余数)' ordered-pair notation mirrors EN '(modulus, remainder)' and keeps ASCII parens+comma as technical notation, a carved-out exception to the HW rule, disclosed); ES escape mirror -> zh backslash runs and literal tab text re-pinned to EN same-line bytes (real-tab conversion where the EN line carries real tabs, backslash-run shortening where EN has the single form; 212 auto sites plus the customs below). 13 hand-adjudicated custom line edits (0344 word-trim precedent): spi.c 1593 返回一个元组集.->返回元组集。, 1750 快照.   */->快照。 */, 2053/2072 太多地方->太多处 with fullwidth dot; 5 escape/tab customs on cross-line sites the spec's same-line rule cannot see (command.c 314 literal tab-text indent -> real tab, 1732 \\if..\\endif -> \if..\endif, 3264 \\if -> \if, 5397/5405 \\watch -> \watch); 4 invented literal-tab-prefix removals (command.c 260-263, EN has clean prose there). One authored custom (fe-exec.c 2737 \\n -> \n) was dropped on site: its target was already single-backslash. The command.c customs were applied in a post-R1/R2-review delta (/tmp/gen0345b.py) because the customs mechanism only fires on lines that also carried spec rows. Budget rule: fix where the line budget allows; budget-exhausted sites KEEP tight and are disclosed: 627 keep lines (599 at exact EN parity pad=0, 28 at pad 1-3; 482 of them with op-sets exclusively within {FC,FO} glue (subset counting rule; 5 mixed D+glue keeps: fe-exec.c 141, logicalfuncs.c 92/207, utility.c 1354, pg_upgrade.c 852; first-op counting gives 484, any-op 487 - both reviewers' figures reconcile under their rules) + 6 HW carve-out keeps from delta-2 (partbounds tuple commas) = 633 entries in the override keep ledger, all spec-row-backed - the keep set is reproducible from the spec+override files and is a candidate for a future block-reflow batch; no reflow was attempted here.
